student_answer: Polymorphism is when one method behaves differently. For example, when you write toString in a subclass, calling it on the parent reference still uses the subclass version because of dynamic dispatch.
notes: Correct on dynamic dispatch; example is decent; could mention method signature requirements.

student_answer: Polymorphism means inheritance. A child class inherits from a parent, so it is polymorphic.
notes: Classic misconception: conflates polymorphism with inheritance. Flag this misconception in the graph.
